motivation: exact event dates are often unavailable in retrospective or low-burden follow-up
fabricating a midpoint or default day would corrupt event-history calibration
month/year reports are naturally represented as bounded event-time intervals

normal_form.rule: DAY has equal bounds; MONTH/YEAR expand deterministically to calendar bounds; INTERVAL preserves supplied bounds

invariants: never impute midpoint or random date
an occurred event can be assigned to a target window only when the reported interval is fully contained in that window
mere interval overlap is TEMPORAL_ASSIGNMENT_AMBIGUOUS and cannot become target-specific occurrence truth
v0.1 event_date migrates losslessly to DAY with lower_bound=upper_bound=event_date
deferred: multiple recurrent events per target window
